dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I know I'm not here on official business, so why did I sound so stern just now? It seems I struggle to break out of work mode.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: The Knights of Favonius were all very busy dealing with the aftermath of the incident. I'm a bit ashamed of myself for it...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: If only I was a stronger leader...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Or at least good enough to boost the morale and the strength of our troops like our Grand Master does...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: No, I cannot feel sorry for myself. We need to solve our problems first. Right?

choices.text: Tell me about the Holy Lyre.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Barbatos' sacred relic, Mondstadt's treasure... The Holy Lyre.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: No wonder it has the power to purify evil...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I hope it will help us save Dvalin, like Venti says.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: If it can, then it truly is a blessing bestowed upon us by Lord Barbatos.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: May the wind guide us in saving Dvalin.
